name: Patient
sub: Mobile web portal, WhatsApp and SMS. No app to install. OTP login; one login manages the family.
steps: Finds a doctor by specialty, name or symptom
Picks a slot; sees fee and follow-up rule
Pays by UPI or card (or pays at hospital)
Gets confirmation with QR pass; reminders 24 h and 2 h
Scans QR at kiosk or desk to check in
Watches token on TV; SMS when 3 ahead
Triage and consultation
Pays for tests at one counter or online
Collects medicines; report link arrives
Gets e-Rx, follow-up date and feedback link
can: Book, reschedule or cancel own and family visits
cannot: Book doctors not open for online booking
Cancel after cut-off without the policy fee
Book more than 2 open visits per doctor

name: Call centre
sub: Phone bookings, reschedules, waitlist and recalls. Caller is identified from the phone number.
steps: Incoming call: patient matched by phone
Hears need; suggests department and doctor
Checks live availability across doctors
Books, reschedules or cancels with policy check
Sends payment link if prepay required
Adds to waitlist when full
Calls waitlist when a slot frees
Calls back no-shows to rebook
Logs enquiry; hot leads go to CRM
can: Book for any patient in any department
cannot: Check in or bill a patient

name: Front office
sub: Registration and check-in counters. Fast search, duplicate checks and tokens.
steps: Starts day: sees doctor availability and late notices
Searches UHID, mobile or ABHA QR
Quick-registers new patients (name, age, sex, mobile)
Checks in booked patients; token printed
Walk-in: picks doctor and next slot or walk-in series
Collects fee when desk also bills
Reschedules or cancels at the counter
Moves patients when a doctor is delayed
Day end: unarrived marked no-show; lists printed
notify: Doctor running late or on leave

name: Cashier
sub: Collects consultation and test charges in one place, with split payments and approvals.
steps: Opens shift with cash count
Calls billing token
Sees all unbilled charges for the patient
Free follow-up and member prices applied automatically
Discount request goes to approval if above limit
Takes payment: UPI, card, cash or split
Prints or sends e-receipt
Requests refunds for cancelled tests
Closes shift; difference needs a reason

name: Nurse (triage)
sub: OPD triage station before the doctor. Captures vitals and flags priority.
steps: Sees triage queue in token order
Calls the patient
Records BP, pulse, temperature, SpO2, weight, height
BMI and sugar auto-flagged
Notes complaint, pain score; confirms allergies
Sets priority: red, amber, green
Sends to doctor queue; red alerts doctor
Gives injections or dressings ordered by doctor
Records what was given and when
cannot: Skip the queue without a red flag
notify: Doctor order for injection or dressing

name: Doctor
sub: Consultation room. Queue, history, notes, prescription and orders on one screen.
steps: Reviews today's list and pre-visit summaries
Calls next token (TV and SMS update)
Sees vitals, history, past reports
Writes notes with templates; ICD-10 diagnosis
Prescribes; allergy and interaction checks
Orders tests and procedures; order sets
Admits or refers if needed
Signs; Rx printed or sent by WhatsApp
Sets follow-up date
Reviews results the same day if needed
cannot: See patients of other departments without a referral (configurable)

name: Pharmacy and lab
sub: Orders from the consultation arrive automatically. No re-typing of prescriptions or tests.
steps: Pharmacy: Rx appears in queue with token
Checks stock; offers substitute with consent
Dispenses earliest-expiry batches; bills
Counsels; prints dose labels
Lab: test appears in collection worklist
Collects sample; barcode printed
Enters and validates results
Report released to doctor and patient
cannot: Sell Schedule H1 without prescriber details

name: OPD administrator
sub: Sets up how OPD works: schedules, fees, tokens, policies and messages.
steps: Sets departments, rooms and counters
Builds doctor schedule templates
Slot length, session limit, overbooking
Fees per visit type; follow-up window
Token series and TV display
Cancellation, no-show and refund policy
Reminder and message templates
Consult templates and order sets
Handles doctor leave with bulk reschedule
can: Change OPD settings (fee changes need approval)
kpis: Schedule changes with under 24 h notice

name: Management
sub: Watches OPD performance and acts on bottlenecks.
steps: Opens OPD analytics each morning
Checks wait time per stage
Sees doctor utilisation and late starts
Tracks no-shows and cancellations
Revenue per visit and test conversion
OPD to admission conversion
Reads feedback and complaints
Acts: adds sessions, staff or counters
can: See all OPD data and reports
